configurations._comment: The whole estate. One process serves /, /website, /design-system, /portals/<slug>, /reports/<slug> and /storybook. There is no per-portal dev server.
configurations.name: hub

configurations._comment: Attaches to an already-running hub on :3007 instead of starting a second one. Next 16 holds a per-directory dev lock, so only one `next dev` can own apps/hub — use this when another session already started it. A git worktree is a different directory and can run its own `hub`.
configurations.name: hub-attach

configurations._comment: The site gate, end to end. Needs a standalone build FIRST — `npm run build --prefix apps/hub` — or node exits immediately with a missing-server error. Password is local-preview, admin is local-admin.
configurations.name: hub-gated
runtimeArgs: cd /Users/akashk/Documents/Projects/MoSJE/apps/hub && SITE_PASSWORD=local-preview ADMIN_PASSWORD=local-admin PORT=3001 exec node .next/standalone/apps/hub/server.js

configurations._comment: Story AUTHORING only. The hub compiles Storybook into apps/hub/public/storybook and serves it at /storybook behind the site gate; that static build wins until you rebuild it.
configurations.name: storybook
